sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Theme colors and base page style
sections.what: Defines named colors for backgrounds, borders and accents, then sets the page background, text color and font.
sections.why: Likely reason: one place defines the theme so every screen uses the same colors.
sections.watch_out: Accent names do not match their colors, so an accent named emerald is actually a grey-green.

sections.name: ::-webkit-scrollbar
sections.title: Thin scrollbar width
sections.what: Makes scrollbars six pixels wide and tall.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: ::-webkit-scrollbar-track
sections.title: Scrollbar track color
sections.what: Sets the background behind the scrollbar to a dark, blue-tinted color.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The color is a fixed value, so it will not follow changes to the theme colors.

sections.name: ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb
sections.title: Scrollbar handle color
sections.what: Makes the draggable scrollbar handle a faint white rounded bar.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover
sections.title: Scrollbar hover and pulse animation
sections.what: Brightens the scrollbar handle on hover and defines the pulsing glow animation.
sections.why: Likely reason: a slow pulse draws the eye to highlighted items.
sections.watch_out: The pulse uses an indigo blue glow that does not match the warm theme.

sections.name: .animate-pulse-glow
sections.title: Pulsing glow class
sections.what: Applies the pulse animation to any element with this class, repeating every three seconds.
sections.why: Likely reason: draws attention to something important on screen.
sections.watch_out: The animation repeats without end while the element is on screen.

sections.name: .glass-panel
sections.title: Frosted panel style
sections.what: Gives large areas a dark, blurred, see-through look with a faint border.
sections.why: Likely reason: a visual style for panels that sit above the background.
sections.watch_out: The panel background is a fixed color, not a theme variable, and the blur can be heavy on slower devices.

sections.name: .glass-card
sections.title: Frosted card style
sections.what: Gives cards a lighter frosted look and animates every change to them smoothly.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The transition applies to every property, so unrelated changes can animate too.

sections.name: .glass-card:hover
sections.title: Card hover lift
sections.what: On hover, a card brightens, its border lights up, and it moves up one pixel.
sections.why: Likely reason: signals that the card can be clicked.

sections.name: .glow-emerald
sections.title: Green glow shadow
sections.what: Adds a soft green glow around an element.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: .glow-indigo
sections.title: Indigo glow shadow
sections.what: Adds a soft blue glow around an element.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The blue does not match the warm theme palette.

sections.name: .glow-amber
sections.title: Amber glow shadow
sections.what: Adds a soft amber glow around an element.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

summary: Sets the app's dark, warm color theme, thin scrollbars, frosted panel and card styles, glow shadows, and a pulsing animation.
purpose: Gives the whole app its look, including background colors, panels, cards and visual effects.
why: Likely reason: one stylesheet keeps the look consistent so colors can be changed in one place.
how: First loads the Tailwind styling toolkit and sets named colors on the page root and body. Then styles scrollbars, defines the pulsing animation, and defines frosted panel and card styles with a hover lift for cards. Last defines three colored glow shadows.
inputs: Class names used in the screens, such as glass-panel, glass-card, glow-amber and animate-pulse-glow, plus the named colors set at the root.
outputs: The visual look of pages, panels, cards, scrollbars and glow effects.
risks: Several glow and animation colors are fixed values instead of named theme colors, so changing the palette will not update them. The accent names do not match their colors, for example emerald is a grey-green.
debug: If a color looks wrong, check whether the element uses a named color or a fixed one. If a card does not lift on hover, confirm it has the glass-card class. If a glow is missing, check the class name spelling.
